python3 - <<'EOF'
import socket, time
def probe(label, data):
    try:
        s = socket.create_connection(('127.0.0.1',6665),5)
        s.settimeout(15)
        s.sendall(data)
        time.sleep(12)
        s.setblocking(False)
        chunks=[]
        try:
            while True:
                d=s.recv(4096)
                if not d: break
                chunks.append(d)
        except BlockingIOError:
            pass
        out=b''.join(chunks)
        print(label, len(out), repr(out[-400:]))
        s.close()
    except Exception as e:
        print(label,'ERR',e)
probe('A', b'')
probe('B', b'\xff\xfd\x00\xff\xfc\x03\xff\xfd\x18\xff\xfb\x01\xff\xfb\x00\xff\xfb\x03')
EOF
